coverage: owned source correlation keys on creation and edit
real commitment completion IDs and parent ownership

corrections: Tasks now validate known generated source keys against their actual owned source rows instead of treating all keys as completion IDs.
Task filing references validate the filings table used by the dropdown and native API.
Rejected task and commitment saves retain drafts and report errors; pending saves disable edits.
Actual local workspaces block provider AI, Paperless sync and browser-runner requests; preparation and records remain available.
AI file references explicitly contain names and sizes only.
Marketplace handoffs open actual calendar and board-pack surfaces; existing setup checklist state survives reopening and refresh; checklist completion does not claim a tested provider connection.
Board-pack creation uses the current atomic native/portable mutation without a partial multi-call fallback.
boundaries: Browser cases use a real local workspace or an explicitly seeded demo against frozen Vite source, not packaged Electron.
Local AI inference, provider OCR, browser sessions and automatic workflow execution require additional host capabilities or a connected server.
AI file-content ingestion is not implemented; picker references are metadata only.
Planned Microsoft/Google/CRM catalog entries do not imply completed provider adapters.
PowerSync production synchronization remains scoped to meeting preparation rather than every module.
harnessCorrections: Required title controls use accessible textbox selectors.
Paperless connection controls can say Enable connection or Save connection depending on saved preview records.
Final browser cases ran serially on frozen source to avoid HMR context replacement and concurrent cold-load delays.
